criteria.text: Diagnosis of major depressive disorder (MDD) in adults (FDA indication and approval criterion 2).
Patient meets FDA labeled adult age: 18 years or older (approval criterion 1).
Patient has tried and failed at least two different antidepressants, each for at least 60 days at therapeutic dose levels (approval criterion 3).
Patient has been diagnosed with a seizure disorder (denial criterion 2).
Patient has a current or prior diagnosis of anorexia nervosa or bulimia nervosa (denial criterion 3).
Auvelity will be taken within 14 days of treatment with a monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) (denial criterion 4).
Patient has severe hepatic impairment (denial criterion 5).
Patient has severe renal impairment (denial criterion 5).

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Auvelity Criteria Version 1; Original: 12/3/2024; Accepted: 01/17/2025; Effective: 03/1/2025. Citation, archived PDF and effective date retained from the stub.

Encoded: closed adult MDD indication, age ≥18, and failure of at least two different antidepressants, each for ≥60 days at therapeutic doses (attestation). Denial criterion 1 (failure to meet approval criteria) is represented by the approval predicates.

Explicit denials encoded: diagnosed seizure disorder; current or prior anorexia nervosa or bulimia nervosa; Auvelity within 14 days of MAOI treatment; severe hepatic or renal impairment. Either severe organ impairment independently fails.
Duration (notes only): initial approval 3 months; renewal up to 12 months. No additional renewal response criterion is stated.
Quantity limit (notes only): 68 tablets within 34 days; maximum dose 2 tablets per day. Duration and quantity enforcement require manual review.

Cautions (notes only): may cause fetal harm; may cause or worsen hypertension; boxed warning relating to risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors. Cautions require manual review and are not additional denial predicates.
